tasks.subject: Task 1: SplashChip variant table + per-chip resolution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One source of truth for per-chip facts (binary name, repo slug, releases URL, macOS gate) and a resolution order that finds the official `splash` binary on M3+ and the fork's `~/.local/bin` fallback.

**Files:**
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashInstaller.swift (extend SplashChip at :5-30; add latestRelease(for:) beside latestForkRelease :123)
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashManager.swift:142-155 (resolvedBinaryPath)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/SplashVariantTests.swift (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- binaryName splash-m1/splash, repoSlug paperniuk|incoai, releasesURL(for:) builds the right api.github.com URL (nil chip → fork)
- macOSSupportsSplash true for 26.4/27.2, false for 26.3/15.7
- resolvedBinaryPath probes override → /opt/homebrew/bin/<name> → ~/.local/bin/<name> → app-support bin/<name> with the chip's name in every hop; stale override falls through
- Full suite green

**Verify:** xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ZGateTests/SplashVariantTests


tasks.subject: Task 3: SplashTarballInstaller replaces rotten fork path
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Working fork install/update mirroring install-m1.sh (tarball + SHA-256 + unpack + current symlink + shim + prune); uniform asset rule for both repos; delete SplashAssetPicker/installForkBinary (spec §3.2).

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Services/SplashTarballInstaller.swift
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashInstaller.swift (delete :69-81, :146-167, :108-109, :123-126 superseded pieces)
- Modify: ModelProxy/Views/SplashTabView.swift:390-427 (fork branch rewires)
- Modify: ModelProxyTests/SplashInstallerTests.swift (drop removed-API tests)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/SplashTarballInstallerTests.swift (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- assetPair picks splash-<tag>-arm64-macos26.tar.gz + .sha256; nil when either missing
- install: sha256 verify (whitespace-trimmed) → tar --strip-components 1 → xattr quarantine strip → replace <tag> dir → atomic current symlink swap → shim written (exact contents, 0755, legacy backup splash-m1.zgate-legacy) → prune keeps current+1 → --version verify
- checksum mismatch aborts with previous install untouched; sidecar whitespace tolerated
- Splash tab Install button works again; full suite green

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ZGateTests/SplashTarballInstallerTests


tasks.subject: Task 5: UpdateSettings + UpdateCenter checks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Observable update-check service: per-chip splash check (release.json → --version fallback vs repo latest), ZGate triple compare vs public repo, launch/daily cadence, per-tag dismissal expiring on newer tags; fork-patch fix to SplashVersion (Review Focus #1).

**Files:**
- Create: ModelProxy/Models/UpdateSettings.swift
- Create: ModelProxy/Services/UpdateCenter.swift
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashInstaller.swift (SplashVersion suffix-aware parse + parseTag :34-54)
- Modify: ModelProxy/Models/AppConfig.swift (update field)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/UpdateCenterTests.swift (new) + SplashInstallerTests ordering cases

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- parse('Splash 1.6.1-m1.1') → [1,6,1,1]; 1.6.1-m1 < 1.6.1-m1.1 < 1.6.2-m1; parseTag on bare tags
- splash states unknown/notInstalled/upToDate/available/failed; zgate states incl. cannotCheck; nil-on-failure everywhere
- release.json reader (fork root, symlink walk-up ≤4) without process; --version fallback
- cadence launch>6h + 24h timer + manual; dismissal per-tag expires on newer; persisted lastSeen/lastCheckAt
- Full suite green

tasks.subject: Task 6: splash auto-apply + manager hooks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply side of locked decision 2: tarball (fork) / brew (official) install driven by UpdateCenter through two SplashManager hooks, one-at-a-time guarded, post-apply version-verified, crash-relaunch never blocked (spec §3.4).

**Files:**
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/UpdateCenter.swift (applySplashUpdate, attach(to:), pending logic)
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashManager.swift (start(profile:applyPendingUpdate:), preStartUpdateGate, ownedStoppedHook in stop())
- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/SplashInstaller.swift (static runBrew seam home)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/UpdateCenterApplyTests.swift (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- gate awaited at top of start when applyPendingUpdate; handleChildExit relaunch passes false
- ownedStoppedHook fires fire-and-forget on deliberate owned stop
- auto-apply matrix: stopped→apply once; owned running→deferred to stop hook / next start; adopted→never
- concurrent apply guarded; post-apply verify must answer new tag else .failed; macOS gate refuses below 26.4
- Full suite green

**Verify:** xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ZGateTests/UpdateCenterApplyTests -only-testing:ZGateTests/SplashManagerTests


tasks.subject: Task 7: AppUpdateService staging + swap
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Explicit-click self-updater: anonymous check vs public repo, SHA-256 + TeamID verified staging, swap delegated to bundled release-swap.sh spawned detached (spec §3.5).

**Files:**

- Modify: ModelProxy/Services/UpdateCenter.swift (delegate zgate check)
- Test: ModelProxyTests/AppUpdateServiceTests.swift (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- latestRelease decodes tag + ZGate-<tag>.zip with sha256 digest; failure → cannotCheck-equivalent
- stage: download → digest verify → ≥500MB free → ditto -x -k → staged app exists → TeamID equals running app's
- swap only from /Applications/ZGate.app; /bin/zsh <script> <staged> DETACHED, never awaited
- tests never execute the real script (injected script-path seam records argv)
- Debug build contains Contents/Resources/release-swap.sh
